subject: Geolock attestation & snapshot proof request
messages:
From: Emily Reed <emily.reed@finwell.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@finwell.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Request: geolock attestation + snapshot proof for dedicated deployment

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing our internal audit packet and need explicit evidence that our Redwood Dedicated deployment is geo-locked to us-east-1 and that tenant data paths do not traverse other regions. Specifically we need: 

- A short attestation on company letterhead that the cluster assignment for Finwell is pinned to us-east-1 and that backups/snapshots are stored only in the agreed region.
- A manifest of snapshots taken during the previous seven days (names + checksums) or an export we can reference.
- The tenant wipe/evacuation playbook steps and an example erase log for a completed purge (anonymized is fine).

We also have a compliance questionnaire attached (finwell-compliance-q.docx). Can you confirm what evidence you can provide without additional contracts or NDAs, and an ETA?

Appreciate it — we're trying to close the SOC readiness review by next week.

Best,
Emily Reed
Head of Security & Compliance
Finwell, Inc.

[Attachment: finwell-compliance-q.docx (DOCX)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emily Reed <emily.reed@finwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: geolock attestation + snapshot proof for dedicated deployment

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front and a proposed evidence bundle: 

1) Geolock attestation: we can provide a signed attestation PDF stating Finwell's dedicated cluster is pinned to us-east-1 for both compute and primary storage. That attestation will include the tenant identifier we use internally.

2) Snapshots/manifest: we can export a snapshot manifest (names + SHA256 checksums) and a JSON manifest for the time window requested. See provisional file: snapshot-manifest-20260911.json (we'll sanitize tenant IDs).

3) Wipe/evacuation playbook + logs: we can supply a sanitized tenant-erase-log (CSV) showing the workflow and timestamps along with the ops playbook that describes evacuation and proof-of-erase steps.

Notes/constraints: we do not replicate snapshots outside of the pinned region unless specifically configured for geo-backup. Any long-term backup/archival policy tied to multi-region replication would require a separate change order; currently Finwell's Dedicated configuration is regional.

Karthik — can you attach the sanitized erase log and the geolock-proof checklist and confirm whether the manifest needs a separate NDA?

ETA: I can get the attestation and snapshot manifest over to you by EOD Monday (2026-09-14). The sanitized erase log and playbook I expect by Tuesday. If you need acceleration we can mark as high priority.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security Programs (Redwood Inference)
Office: +1 415 555 0127

[Attachment: geolock-proof-checklist.pdf (PDF)]

From: Emily Reed <emily.reed@finwell.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@finwell.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: geolock attestation + snapshot proof for dedicated deployment

Vivek — thanks. Monday EOD is perfect. We do have general confidentiality language already in our MSA, so an additional NDA probably isn't necessary for the manifest, but we do require a signed attestation on letterhead.

Two quick clarifications: 
- For the snapshot manifest, can you indicate which snapshots are incremental vs. full and the retention TTL applied?
- For the wipe log, please include fields for: timestamp, operator id (anonymized), erase method, and verification hash. That will help our auditor map it to evidence steps.

If possible, please mark the snapshot-manifest file with hashes so our team can independently validate integrity. I attached the questionnaire we mentioned earlier for anything else the auditor asks.

Best,
Emily

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Reed <emily.reed@finwell.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: geolock attestation + snapshot proof for dedicated deployment

Emily / Vivek — attaching the sanitized tenant erase log and a short technical summary of the data paths. Highlights below and attachments are on the drive link I shared earlier: https://drive.google.com/finwell/evidence/drive-link-ABC123 

- Data paths: In Dedicated, tenant inference traffic is routed via a per-tenant VPC endpoint and processed on the pinned cluster in us-east-1. Temporary KV cache pages are stored on local NVMe and never egressed to other regions.
- Snapshot policy: daily incremental snapshots + weekly full snapshot. TTL: 30 days for incremental, 90 days for weekly full (per Finwell's signed configuration). All snapshots for Finwell are stored in the us-east-1 storage tier; we do not perform cross-region replication.
- Sanitation & proof: Attached tenant-erase-log-20260912.csv includes timestamp, operator-id (anonymized to OP-###), erase method (cryptographic overwrite + metadata scrub), and verification hash. Verification hashes are SHA256 of the wiped manifest; we include a separate checksum file in snapshot-manifest-20260911.json.

I can also provide a short attestation PDF signed by security if you confirm recipient for signature.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: tenant-erase-log-20260912.csv (CSV)]
